dedupe_keys.name: epa ust finder national map of underground storage tank facilities tanks and releases with proximity to drinking water floods and wildfires

description: UST Finder is an EPA web map application with a national map of underground storage tank (UST) and UST release data. Contents: attributes and locations of active and closed USTs, UST facilities and UST releases, combining data from states and territories with EPA data for Indian country, plus derived information on the proximity of UST facilities and releases to surface and groundwater public drinking water protection areas, the estimated number of private domestic wells and people living nearby, and flooding and wildfire areas. Users can import extra layers and export facility and release records. Producer: EPA Office of Underground Storage Tanks and Office of Research and Development with EPA regions, the Association of State and Territorial Solid Waste Management Officials and Tribes. Coverage: US states as of 2018-2019, territories as of 2020-2021 and Tribal lands as of 2025. Format and access: web application on EPA's GeoPlatform with a fact sheet, quick start guide, user manual and download instructions reached from the application's about panel; version 2.0 with newer state data was announced as coming soon. Licence: not stated on the EPA page. Caveats: state data are several years old and not yet in a nationally standardised format (the goal of version 2.0); release records describe reported leaks, not current contamination. Simulation uses: exposure of fuel storage sites to floods and wildfires, contamination risk to drinking water sources, and fuel supply infrastructure mapping. Related records: data-epa-public-water-system-service-areas and data-epa-facility-registry-service.
